parsed.g: Find the customer with the most cancelled orders in history, then calculate the total spend on products in their most recent cancelled orders.
P_t: Navigated to the Orders page at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/sales/order/
Opened the Filters panel on the Orders page
Located the Status filter dropdown with 'Canceled' as an option
Navigated to the Customers list page at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/customer/index/
Confirmed there are 70 customer records in the system
R_t: Filter orders by Status = 'Canceled' and apply the filter to see all cancelled orders
Identify the customer with the most cancelled orders by counting cancellations per customer
Filter cancelled orders for that specific customer to find their most recent cancelled order(s)
Open the most recent cancelled order(s) for that customer
Calculate the total spend on products (subtotal, excluding shipping/tax) in those most recent cancelled orders
parsed.e_t: The agent is currently on the Customers list page (http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/customer/index/). The page shows 70 customer records sorted by name in descending order, displayed 100 per page on 1 page. Visible customers include Adam Garcia (two entries), Alex Johnson, Alex Martin, Alexander Thomas, Amanda Kim, Anna Nguyen, Ava Brown, and Bob Johnson. The page has standard controls: Add New Customer button, Filters button, Columns button, Export button, Actions button, and search by keyword field.
C: Must identify the customer with the MOST cancellations across all history, not just recent ones
Must calculate total spend on PRODUCTS only (not including shipping or tax) in the most recent cancelled order(s)
The 'most recent cancelled orders' may refer to a single most recent order or all orders sharing the same most recent date
